guidance: We expect Line 3 to reach full ramp-up within the next quarter.

capex: We commissioned it in the first week of September 2026 at our existing Kheda facility, taking our SteriPort capacity up by about 75%, from INR6.6 crores per year to roughly INR11.6 crores.
After SteriPort, our next expansion is in small volume parenterals, where capacity will rise by roughly 52%, from INR20.9 crores to roughly INR31 crores during Q1 FY '28.
